# Pinned tooling for the documentation build (.github/workflows/docs.yml) and for
# local use:
#   pip install -r .github/requirements/docs.txt
#   mkdocs build --strict
# mkdocs is held at 1.x on purpose: Material for MkDocs says MkDocs 2.0 will
# break its theme and plugin system. Dependabot's pip ecosystem for
# /.github/requirements keeps these current, and a major MkDocs bump is its own
# pull request.
mkdocs==1.6.1
mkdocs-material==9.7.7
# Two dependencies of the packages above (through requests), pinned because OSV-Scanner
# (.github/workflows/osv-scanner.yml) resolves them to the oldest versions the constraints allow and
# reports PYSEC-2026-4320 in certifi before 2026.10.19 and PYSEC-2026-215 in idna before 3.15. Dependabot
# keeps them current like the rest.
certifi==2026.10.23
idna==3.20
